figurative_meaning_en: once; the day of final settlement
example_sentences_in_english: The punishment for injustice will come one day.
history: Derived from the traditional Bengali proverb 'চোরের দশদিন, সাধুর একদিন', which conveys that evildoers may prosper temporarily like thieves for ten days, but the day of reckoning for the virtuous (saint) arrives eventually, rooted in folk wisdom.
note: This idiom is often used in the context of the full proverb to emphasize inevitable justice.
